top_signals.title: Shell Sells European Onshore Renewables Portfolio to TotalEnergies
top_signals.summary: Shell has signed an agreement to sell its European onshore renewables portfolio to French peer TotalEnergies, the UK-based supermajor said on Monday as it prioritizes capital allocation into high-value businesses. The portfolio included in the transaction comprises 0.5 gigawatts (GW) of combined renewable generation capacity in operation and in development, as well as a pipeline of projects for future development across Italy, the Netherlands, Spain, and the UK.
